steps.text: The mods menu: every mod of the "mods" folder, the Psych ones and the V-Slice ones.
The list: the mods at the top come first. Pick one to see it.
The selected mod, with its icon and description.
These buttons turn it on or off, move it up or down the list, and CHECK MOD lists what it uses that only Vortex Engine has.
Reload the list after putting a mod in the folder, or turn them all on or off at once.
